he: ברא אלהים. ולא נאמר ברא ה', שבתחלה עלה במחשבה במדת הדין לברוא] את העולם, וכיון שראה שלא היה יכול לעמוד במדת הדין לבדה, שיתף עמה מדת הרחמים, שנאמר אלה תולדות השמים והארץ בהבראם ביום עשות ה' אלהים ארץ ושמים (בראשית ב ד):
en: Elokim created. It doesn't say "G-d created," as initially, He thought to create the world through the attribute of Judgement. However, since He saw that it would not be able to endure Judgement alone, he combined it with the attribute of Mercy, as it says, "These are the generations of heaven and earth when they were created, on the day that G-d Elokim made earth and heaven." [Alternative Translation: ברא אלהים Created Elohim. And it is not said that YHVH created, that in the beginning he arose in thought in the measure of judgment to create the world, and since he saw that he could not stand the measure of judgment alone, he shared with it the measure of mercy, as it is said that these are the history of the heavens and the earth in creation on the day that God created the earth and the heavens (Genesis 2:4) ]
